## Unary - with an INTERVAL operand
# Sources: BigQuery's operators reference (interval arithmetic operators); GoogleSQL's
# compliance/functions_testlib_interval.cc (interval unary minus).

SELECT -INTERVAL 0 DAY
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT -INTERVAL -987654 MICROSECOND
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0.987654"

SELECT -INTERVAL 1000 SECOND
=> "0-0 0 -0:16:40"

SELECT -INTERVAL 12345 HOUR
=> "0-0 0 -12345:0:0"

SELECT -INTERVAL -321 DAY
=> "0-0 321 0:0:0"

SELECT -INTERVAL 2 MONTH
=> "-0-2 0 0:0:0"

# Each component's range is symmetric, so negation never overflows.
SELECT -INTERVAL -10000 YEAR
=> "10000-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT -INTERVAL 87840000 HOUR
=> "0-0 0 -87840000:0:0"

SELECT -INTERVAL '0-0 0 100:200:300' YEAR TO SECOND
=> "0-0 0 -103:25:0"

SELECT -MAKE_INTERVAL(-123, 456, -789)
=> "85-0 789 0:0:0"

SELECT -MAKE_INTERVAL(1, -2, 3, -4, 5, -6)
=> "-0-10 -3 3:55:6"

SELECT -CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)
=> null
